description: Project types are overlapping facets, not a disjoint enumeration. Only explicitly documented exclusive pairs can prove disjointness; Tarium can also be Rust.

types.description: Project work across software and non-software domains
A project constructing or maintaining software

A userscript project running in a browser extension manager
